company_facts: Role is based in Irving, TX or Fort Myers, FL (https://jobs.gartner.com/jobs/job/115466-client-engagement-services-specialist/)
CES Specialists connect clients with Gartner analysts, interpret client needs and provide research resources (https://jobs.gartner.com/jobs/job/115466-client-engagement-services-specialist/)
Posted base salary range $56,000-$78,000 plus bonus or uncapped sales incentive; 401(k) match up to $7,200 (https://jobs.gartner.com/jobs/job/115466-client-engagement-services-specialist/)
mission_and_values: Gartner guides leaders who shape the world through expert analysis and objective insights (https://jobs.gartner.com/jobs/job/115466-client-engagement-services-specialist/)

Emphasizes inclusive, collaborative teams and professional development; positions itself as 'the world authority on AI' (https://jobs.gartner.com/jobs/job/115466-client-engagement-services-specialist/)
technical_topics: interpreting client needs and routing requests to the right analyst
learning new internal systems and CRM-style tools
business acumen about technology trends and AI
written communication such as client emails
hr_topics: teamwork and partnering with internal stakeholders
time management in a high-volume client role
technical_questions: How would you work out what a client really needs when their request is vague?

hr_questions: Why Gartner, and why client engagement?
Describe a time you handled a difficult customer or stakeholder.
